The government and LIC have part-sold their stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings in a ₹52,878-crore deal. The transaction marks a major shift in control of the bank, following years of financial troubles and a subsequent turnaround. However, the sale has triggered controversy over the valuation and alleged procedural irregularities. The Opposition and employee unions have raised concerns, while the government has defended the transaction.
Thank you for watching our video!
